import sys

old_stderr = sys.stderr
sys.stderr = captured = []

        list.append(self, s)
    def flush(self):
        pass

cov = coverage.Coverage()
cov.load()
cov._warn('Warning, warning 1!', slug='bot', once=True)
cov._warn('Warning, warning 2!', slug='bot', once=True)
cov._warn('Warning, warning 3!', slug='other', once=True)
cov._warn('Warning, warning 4!', slug='other', once=True)

print('---')

"

tool_audit_index.name: Bash
tool_audit_index.command:
python -c "
import coverage
import sys

# Test 1: once=True without slug should always show
print('Test 1: once=True without slug')
old_stderr = sys.stderr
from io import StringIO
sys.stderr = cap = StringIO()
cov = coverage.Coverage()
cov.load()
cov._warn('Warning 1', once=True)
cov._warn('Warning 2', once=True)
sys.stderr = old_stderr
output = cap.getvalue()
print('Output:')
print(output)
print('Both warnings should appear since no slug:', output.count('Coverage.py warning:') == 2)
print()

# Test 2: once=False should always show
print('Test 2: once=False with same slug should always show')
sys.stderr = cap = StringIO()
cov = coverage.Coverage()
cov.load()
cov._warn('Warning 1', slug='test', once=False)
cov._warn('Warning 2', slug='test', once=False)
sys.stderr = old_stderr
output = cap.getvalue()
print('Output:')
print(output)
print('Both warnings should appear:', output.count('Coverage.py warning:') == 2)
print()

# Test 3: once=True with different slugs should each show once
print('Test 3: once=True with different slugs')
sys.stderr = cap = StringIO()
cov = coverage.Coverage()
cov.load()
cov._warn('Warning 1', slug='a', once=True)
cov._warn('Warning 2', slug='b', once=True)
cov._warn('Warning 3', slug='a', once=True)
cov._warn('Warning 4', slug='b', once=True)
sys.stderr = old_stderr
output = cap.getvalue()
print('Output:')
print(output)
print('Should show exactly 2 warnings (a once, b once):', output.count('Coverage.py warning:') == 2)
"
